title: Meetings of the board.
bodyText: Except for nondepository financial services loan companies, the board of directors of every Hawaii financial institution shall hold a regular meeting at least once every three months.
bodyHtml: §412:3-107  Meetings of the board.  Except for nondepository financial services loan companies, the board of directors of every Hawaii financial institution shall hold a regular meeting at least once every three months. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
